findings: The authorized revision migration test rejects a wrong source checkpoint digest without modifying persisted state. A valid converter changes only strategy state, preserves adapter state and EventLog cursor/commit generation, writes converter/source/target digests, reloads the converted state, and rejects stale revision rollback.
The recorded replay regression set passes 17 tests covering conversion, stale revision rejection, cursor backup recovery, atomic checkpoint/cursor commit, and fencing.

The Windows reconciliation gate tests reject missing, stale, wrong-account, and discrepant reports for live rollback/resume, accept a matching fresh clean report, and keep Paper rollback/resume independent of live reconciliation.

The Windows SQLite supervisor restart evidence preserves desired_revision=4 and desired_running=false with observation phase=stopped after process termination and restart. The lifecycle sequence also demonstrates rollback to revision 2 and restoration of the previous revision after a failed replacement.
The deployment lifecycle evidence validator passes against the structured restart evidence.

Windows local PostgreSQL 18.6 passes cursor legacy import and fencing, immutable deployment blob storage, verified runtime-cache rehydration, and the full distributed/transactional Paper deployment lifecycle. Lifecycle evidence passes its backend-aware validator.

A new Windows file-backed scheduled Runtime Python acceptance commits the strategy checkpoint in one worker process, restarts the worker process, supplies and restores that checkpoint exactly once, avoids replaying unchanged historical bars, advances checkpoint commit generation, and records checkpoint_roundtrip_observed plus checkpoint_input_supplied.

A Windows SQLite Paper acceptance now restarts the actual supervisor after a committed Python strategy checkpoint; the new worker PID differs, checkpoint input and roundtrip are observed, and exactly one on_restore callback records the restored bar_count. The supervisor exits cleanly through the stdin EOF shutdown channel.
limitations: The restart projection is stale/stopped with trading_enabled=null and missing reconciliation; this is a stopped Paper lifecycle result, not live readiness or venue evidence.
PostgreSQL coverage and the new supervisor checkpoint restart are local Windows evidence; Linux CI lifecycle/recovery remains pending. The run establishes no live readiness or venue authorization.
